prompt: Sort a list of strings that may contain nulls so the nulls come first, followed by the rest in alphabetical order. Complete the sortNullsFirst method using Comparator.nullsFirst.
explanation: Comparator.naturalOrder() alone throws a NullPointerException the moment it compares a null element. Comparator.nullsFirst wraps another comparator and adds a rule: null is less than any non-null value, and two nulls are equal. The wrapped comparator only ever sees non-null values, so the sort is completely null-safe.
hints: List has a sort(Comparator) method that sorts in place -- you just need the right comparator.
Comparator.nullsFirst(...) takes another comparator and handles the nulls before delegating to it.
Pass Comparator.naturalOrder() as the inner comparator so non-null strings sort alphabetically.
